_comment: Who is tracked on the Ownership board, and which key each source needs to find them.
Hand-maintained: adding an entity is one object here, never a code change.
`id` appears in the URL (/ownership?entity=<id>) and is the key the snapshot
history is stored under — renaming one orphans its history, so treat it as permanent.
`sources` maps a SourceKind to whatever that provider needs to identify this entity.
An entity with no key for a source is simply not looked up there; it is not an error.
CoinGecko is matched on `symbol` rather than `name` because the names carry
editorial suffixes that change under us — 'Forum Markets (formerly ETHZilla)',
'ProCap Financial (formerly ProCap BTC)'. The exchange ticker does not move.
